name: Island Punch - Indica [20 pack] (200mg THC)
description:
Indica 

Per Package: 200mg THC 

Per Piece: 20mg THC 

With 30+ Indica-leaning terpenes, these fast-acting gummies evoke a mouth-watering tropical punch with hints of grape, orange, cherry, and pineapple. They have a 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration. And like all Wana edibles, they're vegan, naturally melt-proof, and made with organic sweeteners.
